scripts.build: if [ "$WATCH" = "true" ]; then npm run build:watch; else npm run build:once; fi
scripts.build:once: npm i && npm run transpile && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json
scripts.build:watch: npm run watch -- npm run build:once
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run transpile && cp manifest.json dist/manifest.json && node --test test/*.test.mjs
